title: DictionaryEntry
description: One headword (or phrase) with its Hindi layer. Stored in Mongo `entries` with `_id = word`, and in the on-device SQLite as a JSON column.

word.description: Lemma, lowercase. For phrases, the space-joined normalized tokens.

ipa.description: IPA transcription without surrounding slashes. Empty string when unknown.

hindiPronunciation.description: Devanagari transliteration of the English pronunciation, e.g. फ़ॉर्चून.

index.description: Stable position in `senses`; the context resolver returns this.

partOfSpeech.description: Hindi: संज्ञा | क्रिया | विशेषण | क्रियाविशेषण | सर्वनाम | पूर्वसर्ग | समुच्चयबोधक | विस्मयादिबोधक | मुहावरा

styleLabel.description: How the sense is used, in Hindi, when it is not plain everyday English: स्लैंग | अनौपचारिक | औपचारिक | पुराना | साहित्यिक | मज़ाक़ में | क्षेत्रीय | ब्रिटिश | अमेरिकी | कम प्रचलित. Empty for an ordinary sense. Set from Wiktionary's own labels, never written by the model. Absent on entries generated before registers existed.

label.description: Hindi label: बहुवचन | भूतकाल | वर्तमान (वह) | क्रिया-रूप | तुलनात्मक | उत्तमता | अमेरिकी वर्तनी ...
